subtitle: 14 STEPS · ONE IDEA IN · ONE REEL OUT
label: INSTAGRAM AUTOMATION

steps.label: DISCOVERY
steps.title: The discovery engine
steps.line: Every day it searches new tools across 129 categories, rates each idea for virality, and drops what fails a single rule.

steps.label: APPROVAL
steps.title: You pick the ideas
steps.line: The best cards wait for you, ranked by score. One word from you puts an idea in the queue. Nothing is made without it.

steps.label: RESEARCH
steps.title: Research
steps.line: It opens the real pages of the tool, takes screenshots, and keeps every claim with a source. No source, no claim.

steps.label: HOOKS
steps.title: Hooks with an anchor
steps.line: Every hook names a tool people already know and compares honestly. No anchor, no hook.

steps.label: JUDGE
steps.title: The judge
steps.line: 12 to 20 hooks, ranked blind by a separate model, side by side. The winner opens the reel.

steps.label: SCRIPT
steps.title: The script
steps.line: Written beat by beat for a reel, then checked by code: length, one idea, the claims against the sources.

steps.label: VOICE
steps.title: The voice
steps.line: A local voice reads the script. Every line is transcribed back and checked word by word before it is kept.

steps.label: RECORDINGS
steps.title: Screen recordings
steps.line: Claude opens the tool in Chrome and records its real screens, so the reel shows the product, not stock footage.

steps.label: VISUAL PLAN
steps.title: The visual plan
steps.line: Three visual routes are drafted, a judge picks one, and every scene is planned on the word the voice says.

steps.label: BUILD
steps.title: Motion graphics
steps.line: Every layer is code: the paper canvas, the cards, the text, the captions, the mascot. Nothing stands still for half a second.

steps.label: SOUND
steps.title: Sound design
steps.line: A pop on every card, a whoosh on every cut, chosen from a sound map so no reel sounds the same.

steps.label: REVIEW
steps.title: The editor agent
steps.line: A reviewer watches the draft, scores it on nine things, and sends each problem back to the step that caused it.

steps.label: CAPTION
steps.title: The caption
steps.line: The hook as the first line, one clear ask, three hashtags, and a pass that strips every AI-sounding word.
